question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G, scored different marks (out of 100) in an exam. G scored the lowest marks. B scored second highest marks, which were 80. A scored 72. E scored more than F but less than C. Marks scored by C were a multiple of 11 and less than 70. The sum of marks scored by C and F was 120. What is the score of F?
solution:
Given: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G scored different marks (out of 100) in an exam.

G scored the lowest marks. B scored second highest marks, which were 80. A scored 72.

So the order, so far, is _ > 80 (B) > 72 (A) > _ > _ > _ > G.

E scored more than F but less than C. Marks scored by C were a multiple of 11 and less than 70.

The sum of marks scored by C and F was 120. C scored a multiple of 11 and less than 70. The multiples of 11 less than 70 are 11, 22, 33, 44, 55, and 66.

E scored less than C, and the sum of C and F is 120.
